description.value: The Six Mile Pub & Eatery, established in 1855, is British Columbia's oldest pub, occupying a historic building along Old Island Highway just west of Victoria. The kitchen produces everything in-house — artisan breads raised from named sourdough starters, fresh pasta, and charcuterie — while an on-site apiary supplies honey used throughout the menu and in signature cocktails. A multiple-time Times Colonist Readers' Choice winner, it welcomes patrons of all ages and offers a seasonal riverside patio.
